author: Josh Ayen
title: TinCaps rained out Wednesday, doubleheader set for Thursday - NewsBreak
text:
By Josh Ayen No media credit provided. ,
3 hours ago
FORT WAYNE, Ind. (WANE) – Due to Wednesday’s rainy weather, the TinCaps’ will have to wait at least one more night to resume their six-game series agaisnt the South Bend Cubs.
The TinCaps announced that Wednesday’s game has been postponed. A doubleheader is now set for Thursday. Fort Wayne and South Bend play two 7-inning games, with the first contest starting at 5:35 p.m. Game two will follow about half an hour after the conclusion of game one.
All tickets for Wednesday night’s game can be redeemed for any game for the remainder of the season, based on availability.
